title: Outbound request to a computed URL in javascript — review required
description: A fetch, axios, or got call in javascript receives a URL built from a template literal, string concatenation, or request fields. If the interpolated part is attacker controlled, the runtime is a proxy into the private network: internal admin ports, service meshes, and cloud metadata addresses all answer from inside. The rule flags the computed argument, not the trust level of the value.
remediation: Resolve outbound destinations against a constant allowlist, strip credentials from URLs, disable automatic redirect following, and block private address ranges after DNS resolution.
limitation: Lexical match on common client call shapes; taint, redirects, and DNS rebinding are out of scope.
